# FAQ-016 Engineering FAQ #16

Revision: Rev A

Q: What is the dust collector pressure drop alarm setpoint for the Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P2-L1-SB03)?
A: The dust collector pressure drop alarm for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P2-L1-SB03) is 1240 Pa. See maintenance escalation in ECN-2026-019 for alarm response steps.

Q: What austenitizing setpoint should be used for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L2-HT02)?
A: The austenitizing setpoint for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L2-HT02) is 855 °C. Reference SOP-P3-L2-04 for cycle verification and recording procedures.

Q: What is the required coil cooling water flow minimum for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02)?
A: The coil cooling water flow minimum for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02) is 46 L/min. See SOP-P3-L2-02 for flow sensor calibration and shutdown logic.

Q: What torque is specified for the blast wheel liner bolts on Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01)?
A: The blast wheel liner bolt torque for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01) is 100 N·m. Verify torque values during liner change-out per ECN-2026-019.

Q: What target billet temperature is required for Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02)?
A: The target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02) is 1180 °C. Follow control verification and recorder settings described in SOP-P3-L2-04.

Related documents: ECN-2026-019, SOP-P3-L2-02, SOP-P3-L2-04
